name: Human Resources / Atomic Enamel
authority: Owner-selected dynamic Atomic Pulp hybrid hero

typography.display: Hero-inspired tall angular forward-slanted uppercase, cream face, slim coral offset and navy extrusion; headings only
typography.body: Upright condensed bold sans, generously spaced, cream-on-navy or navy-on-cream
typography.numbers: Upright bold tabular; at least as readable as labels

components.use: Compact upward-tilted navy enamel plaque, rounded asymmetric corners, cream/coral trim, corner rivets, one optional yellow star; same form across screens.
Navy enamel well, thin cream inset edge, coral outer accent, subtle directional extrusion. Content baseline horizontal.
One dominant cobalt saucer action; mint luminous lower rim, cream italic label. Compact oval version when space is limited.
Cream-faced rounded trapezoid, navy upright label and pictogram, coral trim; back arrow on left for navigation.
Navy header + cream body, pictogram tile, structured benefit, rank pips; mint selection outline plus check; muted navy disabled state.
Inset navy trough, cream keyline, mint fill; clear numeric label. Gold only for rarity/earned evolution and XP.
Shared cream three-part segmented enamel strip; selected navy/mint plus underline/check; legible upright names.
Cream track with navy rim; mint filled checked ON, muted empty OFF; text label alongside.
Same navy enamel panel over darkened/desaturated farm; upright explanatory text and same action buttons. No competing controls under blocking dialog.
Consistent simple cream/navy/mint saucer, beam, shield, bolt, wrench, folder, speaker, gear and arrow silhouettes; same optical weight.

rules: Preserve low-poly sage farmland/cobalt saucer as world context.
No huge Human Resources logo on every secondary screen; compact screen title uses heading-sign.
Only headings and decorative sign perimeters tilt; body copy, rows and hit surfaces remain orderly.
Do not invent shops, ad offers, currencies, energy, social features or extra screen functions.
At most one dominant primary action, consistent back/footer positions.
Values are illustrative mockup data; runtime implementation and device qualification are separate.
Use paginated layouts for current build, recipes and privacy rather than squeezing every page into one image.
Rank pips belong to hardware or ingredient ranks, and five-pip permanent tracks. Milestone/account summary cards show progress bars plus lock/check status without rank pips.
